query: What do Google Pixel 3a buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: New sim card must be from the same carrier to work. This seller lied and phone is definitely locked! Do not buy from this seller... Update: after doing some digging we learned that most phones will unlock BUT the new sim card has to be from same carrier as phone for it to work or something like that... We almost returned it but tried using a sim card from the same carrier as the phone and it worked...

Buyer Beware - Phone is Not Unlocked. We read other reviews that said this was OEM locked to a carrier, and I should have listened. The phone I received is in fact carrier locked. I will be returning it immediately.

OEM bootloader is locked, This phone is not unlocked.. This phone is not unlocked. My GSM sim doesn't work it is locked to carrier (Ting Mobile / TMobile). Also cannot unlock the bootloader. Maybe this is a random draw of the cards or what?
NOT UNLOCKED. This phone was not unlocked it was locked to carrier when I tried to activate it.

Beware of unlocked. Just got my pixel today. I took it to the Verizon store to get a SIM card. The gal at the store tried several times with two cards and it wouldn't accept it. She told me Verizon is very picky about unlocked phones. So I am changing carriers. I'll write another review after I've used the phone awhile. Just be aware that unlocked doesn't mean your carrier will take it.

Unlocked phones doesn't work with every network.... I spent $400 on an unlocked phone expecting to be able to use it with my carrier, I mean it is unlocked for a reason right? Nope! Apparently the phone is "programmed" for my carrier so I just wasted all of that money on a paperweight. If you're going to sell a phone that's unlocked, at least say what networks it will work for...
Not unlocked.. Was advertised as unlocked. When it arrived I put a SIM card in and it was locked on Sprint.

Phone is not unlocked, can not unlock boot loader. Phone appears to be carrier locked, can not unlock boot loader to install custom ROMs. So tired of these straight up fraudulent product descriptions on Amazon, it's turning into a garbage market where anyone can sell anything with inaccurate product descriptions.

One thing that's really nice about the Pixel 3a is that it works PROPERLY with all the carriers. A lot of "unlocked" phones will work with the various carriers, but will fail to set up properly to run the proprietary apps that belong to the carrier. For example, I have had numerous unlocked phones that did not correctly set up with a T-Mobile SIM (my carrier) to support their voLTE (phone+data) or voice messaging services. The Pixel 3a just... works... Put in your carrier's SIM card and it sets up the necessary functionality for your carrier (at least in the USA). C) Fluid Experience. Yup, it's plenty fluid. A lot of people have bemoaned that this phone is based on the Snapdragon 670 processor, rather than the Snapdragon 8x5 series processors found in flagship phones like the big brother Pixel, the Samsung S10 and so on.
Phone NOT unlocked. Phone is still SIM locked to sprint. Seller didn't have any interest in fixing the problem.

Make SURE its unlocked...mine was not even though it was supposed to be. Ordered the Google pixel 3a (unlocked) but when I went to activate it had a t-mobile sim card and was not unlocked so I couldn't use. Had to return. It was a gift so quite frustrating!

Great seller, fast returns, but carrier locked phone. Phone came in great shape. But it did not come Unlocked. It came carrier locked to T-Mobile. Came in proper packaging, a generic cable but didn't come usable. I'm using an at&t carrier 'cricket' and it wouldn't work due to being carrier locked.

Very disappointing. Although this Google Pixel 3A, sold by Joygoods CR, is purported to be an "open" phone, it is not. My carrier, Spectrum, said it was not compatible with their system and could not be used. Only good news is that the vendor immediately approved the return. Nice looking phone, good condition, but who knows what carrier it is compatible with?

NOT UNLOCKED. Great phone, bought to replace my old 3a, but the seller advertises these as unlocked. However, I booted into developer mode to discover that it was in fact carrier locked, now I have to return it as my carrier won't accept it. I don't know who they are locked to, but its not Verizon. Great phone but if you want it unlocked don't buy from here.
Not Verizon compatable. This phone was not Verizon compatable despite being described as unlocked and compatable with all major carriers.
Not unlocked. This phone is not unlocked. I bought it, took it to Verizon, they cannot activate it. Returning phones.

"mobile hot spot " not works on this phone depend on your carrier.. I am give this phone 3 star because this phone doesn't support "Mobil hot spot " when you use "cricket" sim card. When you try to enable it .The message on the screen will appear "you don't have permission to do that you need to contact "At&T" to purchase the some kind of plan ".I am not use "AT&T" as my carrier and I don't understand why I need to contact "AT&T" ? I try to plugged my "cricket" sim card to Samsung note 9 from "T-Mobile" .Works 100% fine . That means "cricket" do support BYOB Android device. You don't have to purchase phones from them. And also try plug "T-Mobile " sim card into this phone .Also works fine .That means this phone do support "mobile hot spot" So I going to said this phone not 100% unlock for some carrier. Maybe some function not works property .

Purchased for compatibility with Ubuntu Touch - Works great!. Purchased specifically for compatibility with Ubuntu Touch operating system (not android). Works extremely weill. Followed instruction on UBPorts website. Phone was totally unlocked (both carrier and bootloader) as required.

couldn't activate it. the good - the phone looks perfect and arrived when they said it would the bad - i can't activate it. worked with different people at Sprint/T Mobile for hours. Many/most phones can be activated virtually, and don't need a physical SIM. This one does (to activate on the Sprint CDMA network), so Sprint has to ship me one. Its not a big deal, but something I wish I knew in advance.

Not an unlocked phone. This phone is not unlocked. Tracfone sent me a T-Mobile SIM card and it doesn't work on this phone. The message on the phone reads: "SIM card isn't supported. Ask Verizon if this device can be unlocked." Really? So I paid for an unlocked phone that is locked. Don't be fooled by a phone description that claims to be unlocked. It's not. Extremely disappointed (not to mention the aggravation of being without a phone for a week +).
